title: Virus and Prokaryote Enrichment in Coral DNA Metagenomes
author: Natascha Varona
materials: Weigh and record coral fragment weight.

steps.title: Collect and Prepare Coral Sample
steps.instruction: Collect a coral sample of approximately 1cm containing coral tissue, mucus, and skeleton.

substeps.instruction: Use a fresh sample if possible; otherwise, flash-freeze and store at -80 °C.
Thaw the sample on ice before proceeding.

steps.title: Homogenize Coral Sample
steps.instruction: Crush the coral sample using a sterile mortar and pestle until skeleton and tissue fragments are the size of coarse sand.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the fragments and mucus (coral homogenate) to a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Dislodge Tissue and Mucus
steps.instruction: Suspend the sample in 100 µL of Artificial Seawater (ASW) and 0.2 g of sterile glass beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex at speed 3 for 5 minutes (do not exceed this speed or duration to avoid bacterial cell lysis).
Pulse-centrifuge the sample for 3-5 seconds at 3,200 x g.

steps.title: Prepare Sample for DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Collect the supernatant and transfer it to a clean 15 mL microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Bring the sample volume up to 1 mL using sterile ASW.

steps.title: Perform DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 10X DNase Buffer and 2 µL of DNase (10,000 U/mL) to achieve a final concentration of 20 U/mL.

substeps.instruction: Mix by gently inverting the tube.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 hours.
Stop DNase activity by adding 10 µL of 100X EDTA.

steps.title: Filter the Sample
steps.instruction: Bring the sample volume up to 5 mL with sterile ASW and transfer to a 10 mL syringe.

substeps.instruction: Push the sample through an 8.0 µm, 25 mm flat filter, collecting the flowthrough in a clean 15 mL centrifuge tube.
If the filter clogs, pull back the plunger to recollect the sample and replace the filter.
If mucus is excessive, further dilute the sample with sterile ASW before filtering.

steps.title: Lysis and Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Transfer the flowthrough to an Amicon Ultra-15 Centrifugal Filter Unit.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL Buffer T1 and 20 µL of Proteinase K (from NucleoSpin Tissue Kit) to the unit.
Rinse one side of the filter 3-5 times with the lysis buffer using a pipette.
Securely close the unit (seal with parafilm if necessary) and incubate for 1 hour at 56 °C, ensuring the rinsed side remains covered in the mixture.
Repeat the rinsing and incubation process for the other side of the filter.

steps.title: Wash and Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Add 210 µL Buffer B3 to the Amicon filter unit and vortex to mix.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 10 minutes at 70 °C.
Add 210 µL ethanol (100%) to the unit and vortex to mix.

steps.title: Extract DNA using NucleoSpin Kit
steps.instruction: Proceed with steps 5-7 of the NucleoSpin Tissue Kit Standard protocol for human or animal tissue and cultured cells.

steps.title: Elute and Recover DNA
steps.instruction: Modify step 8 of the NucleoSpin Tissue Kit as follows:

substeps.instruction: Place the NucleoSpin Tissue Column into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 50 µL PCR-grade water.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 minute.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 11,000 x g.
Repeat the addition of water, incubation, and centrifugation once more for a final volume of 100 µL.

steps.title: Final Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at room temperature for 30 minutes at ≥ 2,600 x g.
